title: Do Not Commit to Anyone
hook: Vanessa can solve the visible problem or shape the hidden one first.
counterintuition: Direct force looks honest, but it can spend leverage too early. The sharper move is to handle noncommitment while the other side is still reading the surface.
tryThisNow: Find one decision you are about to make public. Move one detail so noncommitment works for you before anyone argues over the larger issue.
keyTakeaway: Keep alignment valuable by delaying capture until the price of commitment is visible.

breakdown.fastRead:
Jonas copies the tally in the trading floor. The commit choice looks small, yet it can shift peace.
